answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day delivers 1 kWh of net heat to a juniper nursery. Its trusted meter kernel signs ID/day and counter ranges; an authenticated cipher encrypts reports to the registry. The registry checks signatures, quota and range nonreuse; failure denies that day's listing. Energy consumption recurs; heaters are reusable capital; no stake. Meter fraud can fake heat, and waste heat lowers cost; owners need not be unique. With honest meters, ten IDs need 10 kWh/day despite shared heaters or parallel delivery: no joule earns credit twice.
